steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Don't worry about it, I'm making some adjustments.

steps.name: Rookie Engineering Operator
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Here... we should be almost done.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Next is to connect the power supply module... Celica, can you check the screen?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: The data... they're stabilizing.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Alright, problem solved.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Thank you... Was there something wrong with my design...?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Oh, no, just a minor issue. The system's operating environment exceeded the universal voltage stabilizer's control range, and the power surge blew out some components.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I replaced all the damaged parts and adjusted the voltage stabilizer's circuitry, so there shouldn't be any more problems in the future.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: To think I've been working overtime just to fix a simple problem I couldn't even diagnose...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: It's not your fault; who'd expect such a simple problem from such a complex machine.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: *sob*—

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Ah, don't beat yourself up over it... Here, you'll feel better after some hot cocoa.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: This is... coffee... *sob*...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Sorry!

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Pudding... Am I just not cut out to be a electrical engineer?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Let's not be hasty!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: At the very least, I think you're really talented at this, and you're a hard worker, too.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: But I always mess up at work...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann always says that rookies have to fail in order to grow.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Last time it was the coupling circuit, and this time I couldn't even find such a minor fault...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: If you look at it another way, you can technically call this progress.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: But I still have to work overtime to clean up my own messes...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: It's alright, I'm always working overtime too.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: But it's different with you, Pudding.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: You work overtime to help us balance out the workload and smooth everything over.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: I mean... you're skilled enough to turn Closure's wild ideas into actual, production-ready blueprints.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: You can calculate an entire project's specs just from the data, without conducting any on-site surveys, accurately enough to build an equipment installation setup in the workshop.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: I have to give it my all just to finish my assignments, but it's probably child's play for you, Pudding.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Celica, I...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not too good at comforting people.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: But I'm sure you've just hit a stumbling block. I've run into difficulties before too, and my grandpa taught me how to face them.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Whenever I feel like giving up, I just recall the happiest I've been while working. As long as I keep at it, I know I'll experience that joy again.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: So... maybe you can try that, too?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: The happiest I've been... have I ever enjoyed it...?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Pudding.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: What... what's your happiest moment like? I want to know.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Me? Let me see... I wish I could say it's whenever I finish my tasks ahead of schedule, but honestly it'd have to be...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Probably when I went to Sami with a Columbian engineering team as a student.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: You've been to Sami? The mysterious land in the north, with all its ancient icefields and majestic mountains?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I've been there plenty of times as a child, because of family circumstances.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: I've only read about it in books. Is the landscape really full of oddities beyond imagination?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Actually, most of my trips were for family vacations, so we never went too deep. My impression of Sami is just a land of pure white.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Except for the one time I followed the engineering team into a wetland settlement.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: A trip to the wetlands is as damp as it sounds, so it's hardly a vacation spot, but... it's special to me.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Wow.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Even now, I can still remember the moment the first electric lamp lit up in the settlement. The smiles of the Sami people are deeply etched in my mind.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: It was the first time I truly understood how technology had the power to reshape people's lives, and bring them... happiness.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: And then I wondered, what if I became a professional electrical engineer, and continued building bridges to the future, just like I did then?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Bridges... to the future.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Hehe, all you have to do is figure out what you want, and then work hard at it. I mean, I'm an electrical engineer now, right?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Oh, I just remembered. If you're interested in Sami, I have one more thing...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: A snow globe souvenir from a Sami resort. It has a miniature model of a Sami settlement inside.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Thanks...
The young Engineering operator stares at the snow globe in her hands, lost in thought.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: ...Yeah! This is it!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Was that directed at me?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Pudding, thank you so much! I get it now!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Ah, no, I just shared my thoughts, that's all...

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: I, Celica Wilson, will not give in so easily! From now on, I'll strive my hardest to improve myself, and at the very least, become independent!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Um... Well, I'm glad you've cheered yourself up at least.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: I must act now, and focus on finishing my remaining work!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I'll also—

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Suddenly, I'm very interested in something related to you!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: M-Me?

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: I just remembered, but haven't you been on this landship for a long time? Closure mentioned that your skills have improved a lot since you first arrived.

steps.name: Celica
steps.text: Have you ever thought of going back to Sami to experience your happiest moment again?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Go... back to Sami?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: (Places a letter on the table)

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: ...This topic again. Father mentioned our old holiday trips, and hopes I can go back with them when I'm on vacation.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Pillow, do you dream of Sami too?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I dreamed of it yesterday night.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I was looking down from someplace high up, at the wetlands, at the Myrkwood, at the snow-covered Fjal Vetrtonn, and finally at an endless icefield.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Everywhere I looked matched up with what I remember.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: The roadside grass sleeping within a blanket of snow, the night pulling over the aurora like a curtain, and the icefield breeze blowing their time away.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I also dreamed of the gift shop where I met you, Pillow.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: You and your friends were crowding the shelf, with snow globes as your neighbors.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: The snowflakes were floating, falling on the small hut in the settlement. I waved my hand and a light lit up the roof.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: What do you think? Should we go back to Sami?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Although...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Help... Is there anyone out there...?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Anyone... please help me...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I'm so scared.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I know my parents are waiting at home for us to set off for Sami together, but it might be dangerous on the way back.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Huh? We'll have friends escorting us home?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: But even so... what if the engine suddenly catches fire, or the aircraft hits a fowlbeast mid-air and breaks down?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: The scariest thought is probably that I'll trip over a rock just when I step outside, and then I fall right onto a piece of sharp debris...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: No, absolutely not! I can't go out that far anymore...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Dreams... dreams are much safer, don't you agree?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Let's have another dream, Pillow.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: We're clocking out, Pudding. See you tomorrow.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Don't overdose on coffee, okay? You're a hard worker, but you should still take care of your health.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: You're the only one who works overtime in the workshop, ever since Celica left.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Celica... left? No wonder I haven't seen her in a while.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Oh, you didn't know?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: She left the landship for a mission two months ago, after she passed her field operations assessment.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Her skills have improved so much... I guess it's good that she's taking on new challenges.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: I heard she was so excited, she had trouble sleeping the night before she left. She had really been looking forward to that mission.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: No surprise there though. I'd also love to be able to visit Sami alongside the Columbian engineering team.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Eh? So she really did go to Sami...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: You've been there before too, right? Ah, I'm so jealous, getting to see all that beautiful scenery you only ever hear about in stories.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Let me tell you a secret. Whenever we chatted, Celica would treat you like some sort of idol. So maybe she went to Sami to follow in your footsteps.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I doubt it... Who would idolize me?

spans.text: I doubt it... Who would idolize

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Do you know, Pillow? Celica's gone to Sami.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I'm sure she's excited to see all those sights with her own eyes. I'm really happy for her.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Huh, at this hour?

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Good evening, Pudding. I've got a letter for you, from Sami. The sender is... Celica.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Well then, have a good night.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I guess I should read it.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: ...She says she's entered Sami territory.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'I had imagined many magnificent sights on my way here, but when I finally set foot on Sami soil, I realized the vastness of this great land exceeded the limits of my imagination.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Fowlbeasts with gray tail feathers soar into the skies, as powder snow falls onto the branches like petals. A mushroom opens up into a crystal-clear umbrella, like a glass bowl filled with sunlight.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'These fantastical sights have had me enraptured since I got here.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: And then there's just some standard greetings. I'm glad she didn't...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Don't blame me, Pillow.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I'll come clean. It's kind of rude, but I originally wanted to pretend it didn't exist at all...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: You know, my parents always mention this and that about Sami whenever they send a letter. So I was worried she'd say something similar, asking me to go too or something.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: But I'm too scared to...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Sorry, Celica! I'll write you a reply tomorrow!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Oh, seems like there's another paragraph at the bottom.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Oh right, my engineer colleagues told me spring in Sami was approaching. Guess what I found in the snow?'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'The answer is in the enclosed photo. Remember to make a guess before you look, though.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: The photo...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: No, Pillow. We have to make a guess before we look.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: You're guessing mushrooms? Then I... I'm guessing it's a pretty ice cube.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Now, it's time to find out!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Ah, the snow... it's melting.
The snow on the grass has dwindled, revealing sporadic patches of green.
A pink flower bud has shed off its white clothing, swaying leisurely in the breeze.
The moment is perfectly framed in the photo.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: It's a beautiful scene.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Pillow, have we... ever seen spring in Sami before?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: You're thinking the same too, right? But it's impossible...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: It's going to take some time to finish my current work, and then I'd have to submit a trip application, so wouldn't spring be over by the time we arrive in Sami? Besides...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: We've already tried so many times... I can't go somewhere that far.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Oh, I know, why not just ask Celica to take some more photos for us?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I'll write her a letter now!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Dear Celica...'

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: Pudding, has Celica's letter arrived yet?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: I just did some napkin math, and it's been almost two months! It should have arrived by now!

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: Ah, I'm so excited I don't feel like working...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Working hours are almost over anyway.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Are you not working overtime today, Pudding? You've been sitting there for the past half hour.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Why don't we go grab a bite together? We can talk about Celica's travel diary. Are you good with spicy food? What about barbecue?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Um, me? I'm fine with anything...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: My favorite story has got to be the time Celica ate the fodder the Sami people feed their burdenbeasts as if they were biscuits, hahaha. That's just too funny.

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: What about the time the engineering team was setting up equipment against the Sami people's wishes, and she stepped in and cleverly resolved the conflict. Now that was a wonderful moment!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: What about you, Pudding? Which one is your favorite?

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Hey, everyone! The thing you've all been waiting for is here—Celica's letter!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Quick, let me see!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: S-Slow down...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Hey, look at this part, haha! I'm laughing so hard my stomach hurts!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Celica says the engineering team is about to leave the Myrkwood, and is heading towards the wetlands in the northeast...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Our captain told me our first stop in the wetlands was near a Sami settlement, where the engineering team had previously installed some basic power facilities.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'I'm guessing there's a high chance this is the same settlement you visited.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'I think you must be as excited as I am to find out how life has changed here after getting electricity.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Although I ran into some unpleasantness along the way, I still couldn't help but burst into laughter from realizing I could fulfill my wish then and there.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Do you still remember what we talked about that day? Going forward, I decided to use my skills to transform people's lives.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'So, my goal is to do everything I can to optimize the settlement's electrical system.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Think you could give me some tips, Pudding?'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Pudding? Are you leaving?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Sorry, I can't hang out with you guys tonight.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I need to... make some preparations.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Good morning, Ball... *huff* The corridor is so cold.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: I was shivering all over when I came here this morning, but I checked the temperature control terminal and the air-conditioning in this corridor isn't even on.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: The cold air doesn't seem to be coming from the vents... but from that direction.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Over there... That's the electrical engineering lab!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: C-Cold... Ah, the floor is all wet!

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Is there flooding in the laboratory...? Is there anyone inside?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Sorry, I'm doing some waterproofing, there are shoe covers are by the door.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: So it's you, Pudding... Are you simulating an engineering environment? Are you simulating... Sami?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Yeah... To be more precise, it's a wetlands environment. This is the first time I've simulated this kind of natural environment in the lab...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: So many coffee bags... Were you here all night?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I'm fine... Um, sorry, could you help me? I'm in a bit of a pickle.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Let me see... Gah! What's this stuck on my shoe?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: That would be the aquatic plants I'm repurposing as cables for the simulation, please be careful.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: This is... Are you trying to test out the latest power transmission tech in a Sami wetland environment?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: I'm sure it could greatly improve the stability and control of long-distance power transmission, but are you sure it'll work?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: In theory. According to the previously established parameters for the Originium substation and power equipment, at any rate.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Celica also helped research and develop the tech, so modifying the equipment and laying out the cables shouldn't be too difficult for her.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: The key issue is controlling the power load. If you look at the power flow calculations here, this part should be able to function normally after modification...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: But given the potential spikes in power consumption after future developments, I realized it would critically overload.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I've been thinking about this for a while, but still haven't figured it out.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Pudding... I think I came across a similar problem before. Could you wait for a moment while I go look up the solution I found last time?
Greyy grabs a stack of papers and wades back through the water.
Afterward, they discuss the engineering issue in earnest, ignoring the 'swamp' reaching up to their ankles.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Sent the letter.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Alright, we're done here. Let's leave the rest to Celica.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Thank you both... for taking time out of your schedules to help me out.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Don't sweat it, I'm actually really happy to get a chance to help you out.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: I have to say though, Sami's environment is just so complicated. The myriad factors you have to keep in mind just make my head hurt. Only you could've thought this through so meticulously without being on-site, Pudding.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: You have to finish this, Celica, so don't screw it up!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I'm just scared of any other variables I might have missed...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: I'm sure your proposal will be able to meet the power supply requirements of a modern village, so please don't worry yourself sick.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Yeah, you've done a great job. We're bound to miss something without conducting an on-site survey ahead of time, so don't overthink it.

spans.text: Yeah, you've done a great job. We're bound to miss
without conducting an on-site survey ahead of time, so don't overthink it.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Besides, the actual environment is always changing, and no one can calculate every possibility.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: ...I guess it would have been better if we did do an on-site survey for this project proposal.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: It's fine, we all know you don't like going outside. No need to force yourself to do something you don't want to.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Am I... unable to help everyone to the best of my abilities?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Why would you think that?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: But going outside... I'm afraid of making a mistake again, or running into some sort of danger...

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: At this point... No need to worry, Pudding.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: If you'd ever like to try stepping outside, we can accompany you wherever you go, just like what we did now.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Pillow, Celica's letter hasn't arrived yet.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Yes, I won't be working overtime today, but I just wanted to wait here.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Should I get a cup of coffee...? I do miss the taste of hot cocoa when I'm not working overtime though.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I look unhappy? You know that I've been at a loss recently.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: In retrospect, I did work on some simulation experiments while helping everyone implement their ideas, back when I had just arrived on Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Maybe those experiments gave me a false sense of security, made me think I could become a good engineer even if I stayed in a closed environment.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: But maybe, things have quietly changed outside, as time flows in the breeze, with us none the wiser.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Oh, how I envy Celica... I really want to know what she's seen...

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Good evening, Pudding!

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Is Celica's letter here?

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Yes, it's for you. Have a good night.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Quick, open it!

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: I can't wait any longer.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Um... huh? When did you guys get here?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: We... just happened to be passing by. Uh, right, we were on our way to get some hot cocoa.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Here, this cup's for you.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Alright, enough about us, what did Celica write this time?

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Dear Pudding, you might find it difficult to take in what I'm about to tell you. I was also shocked when I first saw it.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Let me figure out how to say this...'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: The rest of this page is blank.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Let's look at the next page, I think there's writing on it.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'When we arrived at the Sami settlement, I was so surprised to find that they weren't using electricity—or any other modern devices—like we had thought they would.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'They still use the most traditional means to provide light for themselves.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'So in actuality, life in this community is no different than when the first Columbian expedition team chanced upon them many years ago, and modern technology has changed very little.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: How could this be...? But those smiles...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Pudding... It's too soon to feel bad, there's still more.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: *ahem* 'However, I was also surprised that they hadn't entirely discarded the notion of using modern technology.'

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: 'What they have done instead is live alongside it in their own unique Sami way.'

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Seems like there's a photo in the envelope.
Light.
Pudding sees light, before tears cloud her eyes.
There is no doubt this light comes from modern civilization. A soft, cold light is emitted by the diodes powered by Originium.
But there is not even a single electrical light in the photo.
She sees a horned creature emerging from the forest, like the first ice crystals shaken from the treetops.
Its fur glistens like moonlight.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: So that's an ice sculpture? I thought it was real!

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Wow, so the Sami people actually stuffed light tubes into their ice sculptures to make that shiny fur. It's beautiful.

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: I have to say, this is my new favorite story.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: There's more at the very bottom...
Celica had written another paragraph.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Did you see the photo? I never read about the Sami people doing anything like this in books, but I saw this with my own eyes.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Your efforts didn't change how they live, but this result... I think it feels just as wonderful.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'I don't know if you feel the same. But when I saw that, I felt like I saw something new, and yet ordinary.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Like something that has always been with us, that we've never properly looked at until now.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Sami isn't a static snow globe. This land has always been beyond our imaginations.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'Pudding, I'll continue striving onwards, but not necessarily to change anything. The future will change on its own.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: 'I can't just stay like this, even if only to witness the many different vistas out there.'

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: I... can't just stay like this.

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: I'm not seeing things, am I?

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: Is that... Pudding? Outside?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Oh, hello everyone.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: I'm accompanying Pudding outside to do some maintenance work on the landship equipment. It's the first time she's left the ship ever since she got here.

steps.name: Medical Department Operator
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Don't look at me like that, I didn't drag her out. She chose this on her own.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: She was very enthusiastic on the way here, go take a look if you don't believe me.

steps.name: Greyy
steps.text: Pudding... seems to be trembling a little.

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Scary... It's so scary...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: P-Pillow... I think I really shouldn't... shouldn't...

steps.name: Pudding
steps.text: Go outside!
